targets.restrictions: An adjacent target that has been in the area for the duration of the cast time

description.baseEffect:
Tier 9 · Cast Time: 1 Hour.

You absorb the life force of an adjacent target that has been in the area for the duration of the cast time. They die and you regain full HP, remove all Wounds, and heal any other damaged parts of your body. Also, you can either reduce your current age by the target's level or extend your lifespan by the target's level. You can choose a willing target you can touch to gain these benefits instead if they remain adjacent to you during the cast time.
